title: Official Tooling Adoption
description: Migrated project build and packaging pipeline to official @voiden/create-plugin scaffolding.

Changed: Scaffolded with official @voiden/create-plugin tooling (build.mjs, build-main.mjs, zip.mjs, generate-manifest.mjs)
Added npm run zip and npm run release commands for installer/registry zip asset generation
Fixed: Release now includes the plugin bundle (har-import.js / main.js) and the installable zip; the v1.0.1 release was published without them, so it could not be installed

title: Initial Release
description: HTTP Archive (HAR) Importer plugin for converting browser network captures into native Voiden request collections.

Added: Support for importing HTTP Archive (.har) JSON files
Automatic folder structuring based on page titles or domain hostnames
Conversion of headers, cookies, query parameters, and auth details
Body format support: JSON, XML, Multipart form-data, URL-encoded, and raw Text
Smart static asset filtering (ignore images, stylesheets, scripts, and fonts)
Batch creation throttling with interactive progress and cancellation
